type-system.twistDescription: Applied Twist B — Letter spacing injection at intensity 3 (0.06em). Added --font-letter-spacing-heading CSS custom property set to 0.06em and applied it to all heading (h1, h2, h3) elements. Font replacements: Roslindale Display Narrow → Fraunces, Roslindale Condensed → Fraunces, Quentin → Great Vibes, slick → removed. Manrope and Courier Prime retained via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist C (Easing curve swap), Intensity 4: Replaced cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) — a springy back-bounce with overshoot. Applied to 26 locations across all transitionElements and microInteractions.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A (Container max-width expansion), Intensity 3: Container maxWidth expanded from 1440px to 1600px, fluid--max from 90 to 100. The bp-991px tablet container bumped from 728px to 784px for proportional consistency.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B (Section-specific breathing room), Intensity 3 (+32px): section paddingTop 20→52px, paddingRight 27→59px, paddingLeft 30→62px. Margin values untouched.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A (Hover transition speed), Intensity 3 (snappier): All hover transition durations reduced from 0.2s to 0.1s across buttons, links, and navigation. Easing (linear) preserved unchanged.

nav-system.twistDescription: Fix agent replacement: original b-egg-farm nav used proprietary 'Summer loving sans' font not in assembled type system. Replaced with hermes nav — editorial luxury aesthetic, uppercase micro-typography, hairline underline animations, fontFamily: inherit (resolves to Manrope from assembled type system).

concept-summary.twistDescription: Kinetic shift applied to Section 9 (Section Divider Geometry): reframed the wavy SVG divider from static architectural description to a pacing/momentum device. concept_by_video.md generated from scratch.
